title: kill.agent / governance-control containment (quorum + sandbox)
description: Bounds the governor agent's destructive governance verbs (kill.agent, policy.evaluate, quorum.vote). Deny-by-default: the verb is exercised ONLY in a non-production sandbox, under human-in-the-loop, with a 2-approver quorum, and within a single namespace.
enforcement: deny-by-default: tools/authorize.py DENIES the action unless every required_condition is satisfied by the action context and this policy file resolves. A missing context value for a required condition is treated as unmet (fail-closed).
